meta.title: lokal
meta.description: Planning tool for the move to open-source workplace tools, sovereign hosting and local AI.

shell.tagline: Migration planning for open source, sovereign hosting and local AI
shell.footerNote: lokal produces planning input, not legal or procurement advice.

expert.title: You do not have to do this alone
expert.lead: Where the plan needs more capacity than you have in house, a conversation usually helps more than another document.
expert.disclaimer: This contact was configured by whoever runs this installation. lokal does not vet, broker or endorse anyone.

landing.heading: From your current situation to a plan you can defend
landing.subheading: Your starting point in, a reasoned migration plan out: target stack, sequence, effort, capacity, AI.
landing.ctaNote: Six steps, about fifteen minutes. No account needed.

answers.first: What should we replace first — and what stays as it is for now?
answers.fit: Which target stack fits this organization, and why?
answers.seats: How many seats does each individual change affect?
answers.gaps: Where are we underprepared, and where do we need outside help?
answers.ai: Which AI use cases are viable today, and which should wait?
answers.risks: Which risks, dependencies and training needs are coming our way?

landing.audience: Municipalities, district offices, schools, utilities, associations and SMEs.

preview.title: What a plan looks like
preview.lead: Not a list of alternatives but a reasoned sequence: what first, what later, what stays, what is ruled out.
preview.postureDetail: In phases, not all at once
preview.keepReason: No viable open replacement. Revisit at the end of the contract term.
preview.ruledOutReason: Conflicts with the hosting requirement you stated.
preview.footnote: An illustration with invented figures. Not a generated report.

how.title: How the plan is built
how.lead: Three steps, none of them opaque.
how.step1Body: Six steps: organization, operations, current state per area, stance on AI. Only what you already know.
how.step2Body: Published rules weigh fit, dependencies and effort. Same answers, same result — next week too.
how.step3Body: Target stack, roadmap, capacity check, AI assessment. Immediately, no account.
how.proof: No language model in any of these steps. That is why every recommendation traces back to the rule that produced it.

formats.lead: A report you can pass on — in whichever form the situation calls for.
formats.webBody: To walk through together, with the rationale attached to every single recommendation.
formats.markdownBody: Pastes cleanly into a wiki — Confluence, BookStack, Nextcloud Collectives.
formats.printBody: A4 with clean page breaks. Ready for a council, a board or procurement.

sovereignty.title: Sovereign in the tool itself
sovereignty.lead: A tool arguing for independence should not create a new dependency of its own.
sovereignty.selfHostBody: One container, one file as the database. No API keys, no external services, no phoning home.
sovereignty.rulepackBody: Versioned rules with a source and a review date. Readable — and arguable.
sovereignty.licenseBody: Audit it, fork it, adapt it. What you build on it stays open too.

closing.title: Start with what you already know
closing.body: The intake asks nothing you would have to look up. A quarter of an hour later you have something you can present.
closing.note: No account, no email address, no sign-up.

landing.headingTail: to a migration plan that holds up
landing.headingSpoken: From Microsoft 365 to a migration plan that holds up

wizard.title: Assessment
wizard.subtitle: Six steps, about fifteen minutes. Your answers stay in the browser until you submit.
wizard.submitFailed: The plan could not be created. Please try again.

errors.numberTooSmall: Please enter a number of at least {min}.
errors.numberTooBig: Please enter a number of at most {max}.

descriptions.organization: Type and size determine which recommendations are viable at all.
descriptions.operating: Determines what you can run yourself and where outside support is needed.
descriptions.stack: Pick the areas you want to look at. Unselected ones are marked not assessed in the report.
descriptions.detail: Determines sequence, effort and risk — the real core of the planning.
descriptions.ai: Determines which AI use cases are viable today and which should wait.
descriptions.review: Check your answers. You can still change any step.

organization.typeHint: Determines which procurement, accountability and language requirements apply.
organization.sizeHint: The size band is derived from the number of seats.
organization.seatsHint: People with their own access, not concurrent use.
organization.contextHint: These answers affect training effort and selection.
organization.departmentsHint: Comma separated. More areas means more coordination.
organization.publicSectorHint: Procurement rules, accountability duties, political oversight.
organization.germanHint: Rules out products without a dependable German version.

operating.hostingHint: Where should the systems run in future?
operating.capacityHint: An honest estimate helps more than an optimistic one.
operating.adminCapacityHint: Time available for migrations on top of running what you already have.
operating.itMaturityHint: How orderly are documentation, changes and backups today?
operating.identityMaturityHint: Is there a central directory for accounts and groups?
operating.supportHint: Is an active community enough, or do you need a contracted partner?

stack.notAssessedNote: Unselected areas appear in the report as not assessed — not as unproblematic.

detail.intro: These answers set the sequence. Estimates are enough.
detail.nothingSelected: No area has been selected yet.
detail.currentToolHint: Free text. Leave empty if nothing is in use yet.
detail.seatsHint: May differ from the total — a ticket system often affects only a few people.
detail.criticalityHint: What happens if this system is down for a day?
detail.painHint: How much does the current solution get in the way?
detail.lockInConcernHint: How hard would it be to leave the current vendor?
detail.trainingSensitivityHint: How hard would staff find a change?
detail.keyboardHint: Tip: within a choice, the number keys 1-3 select the matching option.
detail.applyToAllLabel: Apply the first area's values to all

ai.interestHint: Honesty here prevents recommendations nobody will act on.
ai.sensitivityHint: How sensitive is the data that would be processed?
ai.hardwareHint: The hard constraint: without suitable hardware, local AI is not an option.
ai.useCasesHint: Choose what you actually intend to do.

review.intro: Your answers in brief. The plan is calculated from these alone.
review.warningsNote: These notes do not prevent submission. They also appear in the report.
review.warnSeatsExceedOrg: One area reports more seats than the organization has in total.
review.warnNoDepartments: No areas were named, although the organization is larger.
review.warnNoAiUseCases: Interest in AI was indicated, but no use case was chosen.

self_hosted.label: Self-hosted
self_hosted.hint: On your own hardware or server.

eu_hosted.label: With an EU provider
eu_hosted.hint: Operated by others, data in the EU.

basic.label: Basic
basic.hint: A few people can maintain systems.

advantage.aligns_with_public_sector_expectations: Aligns with public-sector expectations: traceable procurement, open formats, auditable processes.
advantage.data_stays_under_own_control: Data stays under your own control ({count} recommended systems with strong data sovereignty).
advantage.hosting_location_is_a_choice: Where the systems run becomes your decision rather than the vendor's.
advantage.open_formats_and_exit_options: Open formats keep a later change of course possible.
advantage.ready_for_local_ai: The target stack can be combined with self-hosted AI.
advantage.reduced_lock_in: Reduced lock-in in {count} areas you explicitly named as a concern.

ai.address_prerequisites_first: All {count} desired use cases require groundwork first.
ai.hardware_below_requirement: Available hardware ({available}) is not sufficient for this use case; at least {required} is required.
ai.needs_a_document_store_first: Without an indexed document base there is nothing for questions to refer to. The repository comes first, then this use case.
ai.no_interest_declared: No interest in AI was indicated.
ai.no_posture_carries_this_data: No viable deployment posture carries content at this confidentiality level ({sensitivity}).
ai.review_optional: Human review is advisable but not mandatory.
ai.review_recommended: Results should be checked on a sample basis.
ai.review_required: Results must be reviewed before use.
ai.review_process_needed_before_scale: A defined review process is needed before a broad rollout.
ai.sensitive_content_leaves_the_building: Confidential content would leave the building. Contractual commitments on processing are decisive here.
ai.start_with_a_pilot: Begin with a limited pilot (AI readiness: {readiness}).

blocker.beyond_comfortable_seat_range: {tool} is not designed for this number of seats.
blocker.community_support_but_vendor_expected: {tool} is community-supported only; you stated a contracted partner is required.
blocker.insufficient_german_interface: {tool} does not offer a dependable German-language interface.
blocker.self_host_without_linux_capability: {tool} is only available self-hosted and demands operational skills not currently available.
blocker.young_release_pilot_first: {tool} has only recently reached a stable release. A limited pilot is advisable before rolling it out to everyone.

capacity.budget_for_external_support: A budget for external support should be planned.
capacity.external_support_likely: External support is likely required for {category} ({tool}).
capacity.pilot_before_rollout: {category}: pilot first rather than rolling out to all {seats} seats.
capacity.plan_exceeds_annual_capacity: The plan requires at least {minDays} administrator-days; roughly {availableDays} are available per year. Either extend the timeline or plan for support.
capacity.plan_may_exceed_annual_capacity: In the worst case ({maxDays} days) the plan exceeds the {availableDays} days available per year.
capacity.significant_training_load: {count} migrations together affect {seats} seats with high training sensitivity.

caution.approaching_seat_ceiling: {tool} approaches its usual limit at this size.
caution.critical_system_cannot_run_in_parallel: {tool} can barely run alongside the incumbent — an elevated risk for a business-critical system.
caution.few_public_sector_references: There are few German public-sector references for {tool}.
caution.license_carries_use_restrictions: The licence of {tool} carries use restrictions and therefore does not meet the classic open-source definition. Public bodies should check this before adopting.
caution.limited_track_record_for_critical_system: {tool} is comparatively young, which matters for a business-critical system.
caution.loses_realtime_collaboration: {tool} removes real-time co-editing. That lowers operating effort and cost, but it is a capability people use daily.
caution.ops_load_exceeds_admin_capacity: {tool} demands more ongoing attention than currently appears available.
caution.thin_german_service_market: There are few service providers for {tool} in Germany.
caution.training_load_meets_sensitivity: {tool} requires noticeable retraining in a workforce sensitive to change.

difficulty.capable_team_reduces_effort: Existing operational capability reduces the effort
difficulty.identity_gap: No central user directory in place
difficulty.no_viable_target: No viable target under the stated constraints
difficulty.origin_makes_it_easier: The path from the current system is well trodden
difficulty.origin_makes_it_harder: The path from the current system is particularly demanding
difficulty.unknown_current_tool: The current system is not covered by the rulepack

fit.can_run_alongside_current: Can run alongside the current system
fit.public_sector_references: References in the German public sector
fit.strong_sovereignty: Strong data sovereignty and exit options

gap.ai_ambition_without_hardware: AI is explicitly wanted but no suitable hardware exists. Without procurement, local AI stays an intention.
gap.identity_foundation_missing_at_scale: At {totalSeats} seats without a central directory, every rollout creates its own account list.
gap.many_migrations_with_low_admin_capacity: {categories} areas are due for migration with little administration time available.
gap.self_hosting_without_linux_capability: Self-hosting is preferred but the operational skills are missing. Either build that capability or start with managed hosting.
gap.sensitive_data_with_external_inference: Highly confidential content is to be processed by an external provider, which conflicts with the stated protection requirement.
gap.several_urgent_critical_migrations_at_on: {count} business-critical projects are meant to start at once and immediately. That exceeds what the organization can absorb.

gotcha.attachment_links: Links to attachments break and need reworking.
gotcha.automations_need_rebuilding: Automations accumulated over years must be rebuilt.
gotcha.chat_history_not_portable: Conversation history cannot be meaningfully carried over. The usual approach is a cutover date with read access to the old system.
gotcha.content_needs_rewriting: Content must be reviewed and largely rewritten.
gotcha.deep_folder_nesting: Deeply nested folders cause problems during the move.
gotcha.email_routing_changes: Email routing has to be changed.
gotcha.external_share_links_break: External share links become invalid and must be re-communicated.
gotcha.informal_channels_persist: Informal channels do not disappear on their own; a binding rule is needed.
gotcha.linked_workbooks: Linked workbooks break and must be checked individually.
gotcha.links_from_other_systems: Links from other applications point nowhere.
gotcha.long_file_paths: Very long file paths cause transfer errors.
gotcha.macro_heavy_spreadsheets: Macro-heavy spreadsheets do not run without rework. They should be sought out in advance.
gotcha.meeting_links_in_calendar_invites: Meeting links in existing invitations keep pointing at the old system.
gotcha.no_clear_owner: Without named ownership the content goes stale quickly.
gotcha.orphaned_permissions: Orphaned permissions must be cleaned up.
gotcha.permissions_inherited_deeply: Nested permissions cannot be transferred one to one.
gotcha.process_must_be_defined_first: Responsibilities and handling paths must be settled before rollout.
gotcha.reporting_definitions_differ: Reports do not match and must be redefined.
gotcha.retention_rules_unclear: Retention duties must be settled in advance with qualified advice.
gotcha.scanning_capacity_underestimated: The effort to capture the existing stock is regularly underestimated.
gotcha.teams_is_also_file_storage: Teams doubles as file storage and meeting tool. Those parts need planning separately.
gotcha.template_formatting_drift: Elaborately designed templates shift in layout.
gotcha.tool_cannot_create_process: A tool does not replace a missing way of working.
gotcha.wiki_macros_do_not_transfer: Macros and embedded elements do not transfer.

keep.effort_outweighs_current_benefit: {category}: the effort ({difficulty}) currently outweighs the benefit. Not a pressing project.
keep.no_suitable_target_yet: {category}: under the stated constraints there is currently no viable alternative.

not_modelled.negotiated_contract_terms: Negotiated contract terms, discounts and framework agreements

next.pilot_ai_use_case: Set up a pilot for the AI use case {useCase}.
next.plan_first_phase: Plan the first phase with {count} projects in concrete terms.
next.verify_recommendations_against_current_r: Check the recommendations against the current state of the products (rulepack {rulepackVersion}).

note.categories_not_assessed: {count} areas were not assessed and are not evaluated in this plan.
note.category_seats_exceed_organization: {category} reports {seats} seats while the organization has {totalSeats} in total. Please check.
note.no_candidate_survived_constraints: For {category}, none of the {considered} options examined survived the stated constraints.
note.no_departments_named: No areas were named for {totalSeats} seats, which makes coordination effort harder to judge.
note.public_sector_implied_by_org_type: As a {orgType}, public-sector expectations apply regardless of what was ticked.

phase.complex_or_cannot_run_in_parallel: High effort ({difficulty}) or no parallel operation possible.
phase.deferred_to_spread_critical_change: Deferred to keep at most {limit} business-critical change(s) running at once.
phase.optimization_and_local_ai: Optimization and local AI once the foundation is in place.
phase.prerequisites_before_anything_else: {count} prerequisites must be in place before any migration.
phase.waits_for_dependency: Waits for {dependsOn}, which this system builds on.

revisit.at_contract_renewal: Re-examine at the next contract renewal.

savings.excludes_internal_time_costs: Internal staff time is not valued in this assessment.
savings.external_support_cost: External support should be planned for {count} projects.
savings.hosting_under_own_control: Operating costs become something you shape rather than something set by a vendor.
savings.migration_effort_upfront: The migration effort of {minDays} to {maxDays} administrator-days comes first.
savings.model_is_qualitative: The overall assessment is qualitative. Any amounts shown are not a forecast — they are your own figures multiplied by published list prices.
savings.parallel_running_costs: Across {phases} phases, old and new systems run alongside each other for a time.
savings.priced_exposure_partial: Only {priced} of {assessed} assessed areas carry a citable list price, so the amount shown is a partial sum rather than a total.
savings.prices_are_list_prices: Based on the vendors' published list prices. Your actual contract terms may differ; check against your own invoices.
savings.procurement_flexibility: More room to manoeuvre in procurement.
savings.recurring_licence_exposure_reduced: Recurring licence exposure for {tool} across {seats} seats falls away.
savings.subscription_not_fully_replaced: {plan} does not fall away yet: {remaining} area(s) still run on this subscription. The contract ends only once the last of them is replaced.
savings.support_contracts_still_needed: Support contracts remain necessary and offset part of the saving.

scale.additional_departments_manageable: Additional areas can be taken on without rebuilding.
scale.ai_needs_foundations_first: The foundations for broader AI use are not yet in place.
scale.can_take_more_in_house_over_time: More can be taken in-house over time.
scale.close_to_current_limit: At {seats} seats the target stack sits close to its usual limit ({tool}).
scale.comfortable_at_current_size: The target stack is comfortably sized for {seats} seats.
scale.identity_needed_before_more_departments: User management needs sorting before taking on further areas.
scale.review_before_significant_growth: Before significant growth, re-assess {tool} (comfortable to roughly {comfortableUpTo}).
scale.room_for_growth: There is room for growth ({tool} carries to roughly {comfortableUpTo}).
scale.self_hosting_supports_stricter_rules: Self-hosting supports stricter requirements later without changing the stack.
scale.stack_supports_broader_ai_later: The stack supports broadening AI use later.
scale.start_managed_move_in_house_later: Start with managed hosting and bring it in-house as capability grows.

report.title: Migration plan
report.draftRulepackNotice: Note: rulepack {version} has not yet been checked against current product releases by a qualified reviewer. The ratings are careful but unconfirmed — verify before any procurement decision.

postureNarrative.prepare_first: The target stack holds up; the organization does not yet, in decisive places. Without the prerequisites named here the effort only moves later — and gets more expensive.
postureNarrative.start_selectively: Some work can start now, some needs groundwork first. Section 5 is ordered accordingly.
postureNarrative.proceed: The preconditions are broadly met. The plan can be approached in the order proposed.

aiNarrative.not_now: The foundations for AI are not in place yet. That is a question of sequence, not a failing.
aiNarrative.start_small: AI is feasible, but as a limited pilot with human review first.
aiNarrative.proceed: Some AI use cases are viable today; the detail is in section 7.

summary.title: Executive summary
summary.target: The plan proposes {planned} migrations. {keep} areas should stay as they are for now.

savings.title: Savings outlook
savings.exposureCoverage: Evidenced for {priced} of {assessed} assessed areas, across {seats} seats.
savings.exposureNote: Your own figures multiplied by published list prices — not an estimate, not a forecast.
savings.basisLine: {plan}: {unit} per seat per month, {seats} seats ({term}, {tax}, observed {observed})

stack.title: Recommended target stack
stack.lead: One reasoned recommendation per area, with fallbacks and the candidates ruled out.

roadmap.title: Migration roadmap
roadmap.lead: Sequence, effort and affected seats per phase. Effort is a planning estimate in admin days.
roadmap.keepForNow: Keep as they are for now
roadmap.keepForNowLead: These areas should not be touched right now. That is a deliberate recommendation, not a gap in the plan.

0.title: Phase 0 — Prerequisites
0.goal: Establish the foundations every later step builds on.

1.title: Phase 1 — Quick wins
1.goal: Projects with noticeable benefit at manageable effort.

2.title: Phase 2 — Moderate projects
2.goal: Changes with higher coordination and training needs.

3.title: Phase 3 — Demanding projects
3.goal: Complex or business-critical changes needing their own project structure.

4.title: Phase 4 — Optimization and local AI
4.goal: Consolidation and the first AI use cases.

capacity.title: Readiness and capacity
capacity.lead: How much the organization can carry, in the places that matter.
capacity.budgetLine: The plan requires roughly {min}–{max} administrator-days. An estimated {availableMin}–{availableMax} days are available per year.
capacity.estimateNote: A planning estimate in ranges — not a quote and not a commitment.

ai.title: Local AI
ai.lead: Which use cases are viable today, which deserve a pilot, and which should wait.

scalability.title: Scalability and outlook
scalability.lead: Whether the recommended stack still holds as the organization changes.

method.title: Method and limits
method.lead: Calculated from your answers and a fixed rulepack. No language model involved; same answers, same result.
method.linkNotice: The link is unguessable but unprotected. Treat it as an internal document.

notFound.title: Report not found
notFound.body: There is no report at this link. It may have been removed, or the link may be incomplete.

report.rulesChanged: Note: recalculated with a newer rulepack because the original version ({version}) is no longer available. Some recommendations may differ.
